conclusion: Capture-to-argument scalarization has measurable cold-build headroom. This is a deliberately semantically invalid omission probe, not an optimization or a promised speedup. No compiler implementation changed.

methodology: Fresh processes and disabled persistent compilation caches; same read-only loader for both modes; six alternating samples; no concurrent task tests or builds; shared host, no OS page-cache flush. Instruction attribution ran separately. All three control binaries are byte-identical to the uninstrumented baseline. Source/dist fingerprint verified across timings.

paired.control: DIAGNOSTIC ABLATION, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION: read-only loader replaces RunEffectValue/CatchEffect capture materialization with typed null argument values in omit mode. Outputs are deliberately semantically invalid and never executed. Both modes have identical source/dist and loader; omit output is made non-executable.
